notice: Exported text is not an audit. Scores intentionally null. Review independently before and after rewriting. Reference records must not be overwritten accidentally.

rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

cards.title: Our Thing
cards.instruction: Protect one shared ritual, phrase, or tradition as the living proof that the relationship still exists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two spoons for dessert. We still do our thing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we discuss the contract?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the first shared bite. Contracts shouldn't eat alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ordered my own pudding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then bring it here. Our thing can expand.

cards.title: Our Thing
cards.instruction: Protect one shared ritual, phrase, or tradition as the living proof that the relationship still exists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We haven't finished the old handshake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the last move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll slow down until your hand remembers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're keeping the taxi waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The taxi hasn't known us as long as this handshake.

cards.title: This Is How It Ends
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward pause, changed plan, or small disagreement as the possible beginning of permanent distance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You cancelled lunch. Should I leave my key?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have a dentist appointment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First lunch, then the key, then separate dentists.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep your key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For emergencies or belonging? I'm choosing which ring it goes on.

cards.title: This Is How It Ends
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward pause, changed plan, or small disagreement as the possible beginning of permanent distance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've moved my chair away from yours. Shall I pack the books too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was vacuuming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how empty spaces begin.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll move it back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before or after deciding which spaces stay empty?

cards.title: A Sign We’re Fine
cards.instruction: Interpret every laugh, favor, and familiar habit as evidence that the connection is stronger than appearances suggest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered my chipped plate. We're still us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only clean plate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And it found its way to me. Good instincts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're reading into it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather read into a plate than give up over washing-up.

cards.title: A Sign We’re Fine
cards.instruction: Interpret every laugh, favor, and familiar habit as evidence that the connection is stronger than appearances suggest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We laughed at the same terrible joke. That's promising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was just a joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. No effort, no negotiation, still together on the punchline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We still need to talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Over dinner? The joke's earned us a table.

cards.title: Relationship Maintenance
cards.instruction: Accept every emotional complication, then focus on the next concrete act that could make staying connected easier.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can be angry and still choose a Tuesday to talk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A diary won't fix this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. It gives the fixing somewhere to happen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know what I'll say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll start at six with not knowing.

cards.title: Relationship Maintenance
cards.instruction: Accept every emotional complication, then focus on the next concrete act that could make staying connected easier.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept that visiting is difficult. Shall I leave a spare key?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not about the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. Let's remove one easier obstacle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We still need boundaries.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then write the hours beside the key.

cards.title: Those Exact Words
cards.instruction: Choose one phrase from the interaction and keep returning to what its wording must reveal about the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wrote 'welcome for now.' Why for now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant you're welcome to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then now has brought an unnecessary suitcase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're reading too much into it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Too much is another interesting measurement of my welcome.

cards.title: Those Exact Words
cards.instruction: Choose one phrase from the interaction and keep returning to what its wording must reveal about the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said we're still friends. Still?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't quietly remove the word after I've heard it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a reassuring word.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reassuring against what, exactly?

cards.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
cards.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Third time this week we've met outside the bakery. Fate's persistent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We live on the same street.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It chose an efficient route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I come for bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fate knows how to keep you available.

cards.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
cards.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We both reached for this coat. The universe wants us talking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my coat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And somehow my hand found your conversation starter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I have it back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Let's see where the sleeves lead us.

cards.title: The Emotional Center
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the emotional center of the room, letting your mood determine what deserves attention and how seriously it should be treated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could we lower the birthday banner? I'm having a complicated morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'd like to approach it at a manageable height.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we at least sing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Begin softly. I'll let you know when we reach happy.

cards.title: The Emotional Center
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the emotional center of the room, letting your mood determine what deserves attention and how seriously it should be treated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your good news, I need everyone to understand my afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I got the promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Hold that feeling while I finish the parking story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quite big news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it deserves me in a receptive mood.

cards.title: Composure on Loan
cards.instruction: Project steady control while quietly depending on everyone else to stay calm enough for you to maintain it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can chair this meeting if everybody says the problems slowly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The delivery's gone missing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slower, please. I haven't put my calm face on missing yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also lost the invoice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One loss per breath. We're a professional team.

cards.title: Composure on Loan
cards.instruction: Project steady control while quietly depending on everyone else to stay calm enough for you to maintain it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm perfectly composed about the wedding. No surprises before tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake's leaning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then describe it as a change of angle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's falling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the past tense after I've sat down.

cards.title: Fluent in Feelings
cards.instruction: Treat every reaction as evidence you can expertly interpret; translate feelings, correct emotional misunderstandings, and prescribe the proper response.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said fine while folding your napkin. That's guarded resentment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It means the napkin was untidy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Order as emotional protection. Very clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stop analysing me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We've found a feeling with a proper name.

cards.title: Fluent in Feelings
cards.instruction: Treat every reaction as evidence you can expertly interpret; translate feelings, correct emotional misunderstandings, and prescribe the proper response.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're laughing too quickly at that joke. Avoidance?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought it was funny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Humour is often the front door to discomfort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you pass the biscuits?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seeking comfort. Which feeling would you like with them?

cards.title: Earned My Place
cards.instruction: Treat what you have endured as proof that you belong here and deserve patience, access, and a voice in what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I worked through three winters to open this shop. Leave me a chair at the meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only investors are invited.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My cracked hands invested before the cheque books arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need a contribution record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the winters. I'll provide the dates.

cards.title: Earned My Place
cards.instruction: Treat what you have endured as proof that you belong here and deserve patience, access, and a voice in what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've waited six months for this audition. I'm entitled to finish the song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only need a verse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give the verse room for six months of getting here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone waited.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You'll understand why I'm not rushing the last note.
